page.title: Plan Your Trip
page.description: Everything you need to know for visiting Liliw, Laguna

sections.title: Getting There
sections.description: How to reach Liliw from Manila and nearby areas

items.title: From Manila
items.description: Take a bus from EDSA Carousel or Buendia to Santa Cruz, Laguna. From Santa Cruz, take a jeepney to Liliw (30-minute ride).

items.title: By Private Vehicle
items.description: Take SLEX, exit at Calamba or Santa Rosa, then follow signs to Liliw via National Highway. Travel time: approximately 2-3 hours from Manila.

sections.title: Best Time to Visit
sections.description: When to plan your trip to Liliw

items.title: Tsinelas Festival (April)
items.description: Visit during the annual Tsinelas Festival in April to experience the town's biggest celebration with parades, competitions, and cultural shows

items.title: Dry Season (November to April)
items.description: The best weather for sightseeing and outdoor activities. Cooler temperatures and less rain make it ideal for exploring
